brief: A luxury curated platform for Egypt's premier royal palaces, Nile heritage waterfronts, and diplomatic summit venues. The identity embodies the authentic Egyptian spirit of gathering (اللمة) with timeless architectural prestige.
criteria: Scales down to 16px as a clean favicon, reproduces in 1-color black/white, embodies gathering (اتلموا), and conveys sovereign Egyptian palace heritage.

concepts.name: The Sovereign Conclave (المجلس الملكي)
concepts.idea: Four sweeping royal vaults converge inward in celebratory assembly around an 8-pointed star pavilion, embodying guests gathering together ('اتلموا') under one sovereign roof.
rationale: Directly translates 'اتلموا' (gather up) into architectural convergence from North, South, East, and West
Subtly forms the Latin initial 'E' laterally and the Arabic calligraphic sweep of 'ـوا'
100/100 production-readiness audit score; perfectly balanced 14px margins on 256x256 canvas
Scales effortlessly down to 16px favicon and up to bronze palace entrance signage

recommendation: Concept A (The Sovereign Conclave) is selected and implemented as the official brand identity for Etlamo across all digital and physical touchpoints.
